vision.input: data: URL or bare base64 in an image content part; http(s) URLs are refused

decode: greedy at temperature 0 (the default); sampled at temperature > 0

prompt_lookup.applies_to: greedy requests with the mtp drafter, or with no head at all (HALOGEN_MTP=0)

tool_calls.required_is_exact: named tool_choice, one tool, or any strict tool

server_defaults_rule: a field the request sends always wins; a default fills only a field the request omits. A request that sends temperature 0 decodes greedy and takes no sampling default

structured_output.sampling: any temperature: each token is drawn from the model's distribution over the tokens the schema allows next (top_p, top_k and min_p act on that distribution); logprobs with a schema are a 400
structured_output.images: a schema with images is a 400
structured_output.thinking: the reasoning block is unconstrained; the final text is constrained after </think>
structured_output.tools: a request with tools may open a <tool_call> instead of the JSON (the schema binds the final text; a call is held to its tool's schema when the tool is strict)
structured_output.keys: object keys are emitted in schema order

strict_tools.guarantee: when any tool is strict, a call names a declared tool, and a strict tool's arguments match its parameter schema
strict_tools.arguments: keys in any order, each at most once; extra keys are refused unless the schema allows them inside an argument; a string argument cannot contain the line </parameter>
strict_tools.parallel_tool_calls: false allows one call when a tool on the request is strict
strict_tools.not_enforced: a strict tool whose schema uses a refused keyword, allows extra keys at the top or has more than 32 parameters, and every strict tool on a request with images, logprobs or more than 128 tools, is called as without strict; counted in /metrics and named in the request's log line
strict_tools.thinking: a call written inside the reasoning block is not held to a schema

sampling.decode: temperature 0 (the default) is greedy: a forward pass and an argmax, byte-identical to serial greedy decode. temperature > 0 samples from the filtered target on the same drafter the request would otherwise get; with the MTP drafter the speculative accept/reject rule emits exactly the target distribution
sampling.filters: top_k, top_p and min_p compose as an intersection (the HF/vLLM convention); top_p >= 1 and top_k = 0 disable a filter. A sampled request that omits top_k or top_p takes the operator's default, else the model's (filter_defaults)
sampling.seed: reproduces a request on the same drafter; a sampled MTP run and a sampled serial run agree in distribution, not token for token
sampling.penalties: presence and frequency count GENERATED tokens only; repetition_penalty scales every id in the prompt or the output (vLLM's rule); applied on both drafters
sampling.logprobs: a sampled request carries the chosen token's logprob on every token; at temperature 0, and with top_logprobs (up to 20) at any temperature, the first generated token only, so those need max_tokens 1
not_implemented: logprobs past the first token at temperature 0
